usedFor: Intercom is where support tickets arrive and Google Calendar is where the team's time is planned. A “New Ticket Created” in Intercom can run “Update Event” in Google Calendar, moving a slot or its attendees when a ticket comes in.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket Created” in Intercom, then “Update Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: A new ticket can mean a call or a block of time already on the calendar needs to change. “Update Event” changes time, attendees and details, with guest notifications.

watchOut: “Update Event” works on an event in a chosen calendar, so you must point it at one that exists. “Create Calendar” makes a whole new calendar for every ticket, which you rarely want.
